# parity-fuzz --mode nest baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode nest --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# KNOWN GAP (one bug, many shapes): a DOUBLE-QUOTED nested expansion carrying an
# outer operator keeps the INNER expansion's array-shape flags, where zsh drops
# them. In zsh a scalar context (`ssub`, Src/subst.c:1759) sepjoins the array and
# clears `isarr` (c:3901-3907), and the sort/unique block sits inside an
# `if (isarr)` gate (c:4245) — so `(o)`/`(u)`/`(n)`/`(q)` are no-ops inside "…":
#
#   a=(one two three four)
#   print -r -- "[${(o)a}]"           -> [one two three four]   (both agree: NOT sorted)
#   print -r -- "[${${(o)a}//o/0}]"   -> zsh:   [0ne tw0 three f0ur]   (inner (o) dropped)
#                                       zshrs: [f0ur 0ne three tw0]   (inner (o) applied)
#
# zshrs honours the rule at ONE level (the qt/c:3034 path) but a nested inner is
# evaluated by multsub in a fresh unquoted context, so it sorts and the outer
# operator then runs over the sorted array. UNQUOTED forms already match.
# Pre-existing; independent of the assoc / LF_ARRAY fixes in this commit.
# Fix path: port the c:3901-3907 ssub arm and make the nested inner inherit the
# outer's scalar context.
  print -r -- "[${${(L)${(n)a}}//o/0}]"
  print -r -- "[${${(n)a}#*_}]"
  print -r -- "[${${(o)${(o)a}}//o/0}]"
  print -r -- "[${${(o)nums}//o/0}]"
  print -r -- "[${${(q)nums}//o/0}]"
  s=Hello_World; t=a:b:c:d; path=/usr/local/bin/zsh; lines=$'aa\nbb\ncc'; a=(one two three four); nums=(3 1 4 1 5); typeset -A m; m=(k1 v1 k2 v2); ptr=s; empty='';

[1 1 3 4 5]
[3 1 4 1 5]
[3\ 1\ 4\ 1\ 5]
[f0ur 0ne three tw0]
[four one three two]
[one two three four]

print -r -- "[${${(n)${(U)a}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(n)a}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(n)a}#*_}]"

print -r -- "[${${(n)nums}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(O)${(L)a}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(O)${(n)a}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(o)${(o)a}}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(O)${(o)a}}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(o)${(q)nums}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(o)${(U)a}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(o)${(U)nums}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(O)${(U)nums}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(o)a}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(O)a}#*_}]"

print -r -- "[${${(q)m}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(q)nums}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(s.:.)${(o)a}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(s.:.)${(O)nums}}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${(u)${(n)nums}}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(u)${(O)a}}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(u)${(o)nums}}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${(u)nums}#*_}]"
print -r -- "[${${#${(L)m}}//o/N}]"
print -r -- "[${${#${(q)nums}}//o/N}]"

print -r -- "[${${${(U)path}[N]}#*_}]"
